name: Asana
shortInfo: Asana is a web-based task management and collaboration tool.
brief: Asana is a web and mobile work management platform designed to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.
about:
Get access to records of tasks, users and much more through this Asana connector. It enables streaming of relevant Asana data into a user determined data warehouse automatically once you configure the relevant pipelines.

Check more about asana api documentation [here](https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference).
availableData:
[**Users**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/asana/pipelines/users.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all users in the specified workspace.

[**Teams**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/asana/pipelines/teams.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all teams in the specified workspace.

[**Tasks**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/asana/pipelines/tasks.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve all tasks in the specified workspace.

[**Custom Fields**](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_application/asana/pipelines/custom-fields.html)

This pipeline can be used to request and retrieve a list of all of the custom fields settings on a workspace, in compact form.
